sectionNote: one VStack: the full-width 新会话 capsule, its fixed-height reason line, an optional failure row, and one collapsible group per folder. The 文件夹 header with its + button, the empty-folder hint and folder rename/delete are behind HomeDrawer.foldersEnabled (false: not offered yet). PR64 removed the drawer's bottom settings bar; shell navigation is the separate HomeTabBar. The source groups with VStack/ScrollView, not Section/PageSection/GroupBox, so there is no section title tree to compare; the actions are the comparable structure
titleNote: the drawer has no navigation title; NativeShell names the panel 会话列表 in accessibility only (`NativeShell.swift:325`), which is chrome, not a page heading

source.sectionOrder: declaration order inside the page struct

android.note: the Android PR22 drawer body is HomeDrawer; PdshDrawer owns only the overlay/scrim container

handRegistered.reason: HomeDrawer is not a `*Page` struct, so `extract_ios_pages.py` does not generate a contract for it. PR22 made it the product drawer (`NativeShell.swift:304` `SessionsDrawerPanel` → `HomeDrawer`), which is a real surface with its own session/folder controls, so it must not disappear from the gate. PR64 removed the bottom settings bar (now HomeTabBar).
handRegistered.mechanism: a whole contract file, not a `_spec-required.json` entry: that file merges items into an extracted contract, and the extractor has no `*Page` contract to merge into. `extract_ios_pages.py` never writes or deletes `pages/home-drawer.json`; `check_chrome_contracts` verifies this file and its declared struct still exist, and `page_structure_check.py` compares it like every other contract, provenance included.
handRegistered.homeSpec: `HomeSpec.swift` is the 430x932 value authority behind this drawer and ChatPage (page #F7F7F7, text #1A1A1A, 16/24 body, 16 chrome vs 20 content inset, radii and spacing). It declares no View struct, so it has no page contract of its own; `extract_ios_pages.py` pins the file in CHROME_VALUE_FILES and README §1.1 records it.
